svg.text: GRAFCET (IEC 60848) – HMC01 with pallet changer and manual load station (crankcase line L2)
Load/unload at the station (120 s) runs IN PARALLEL with machining (345 s). Only the pallet change (8.8 s) adds to the cycle.
Lamp yellow · check home: APC 0°, arm down, clamps OK
Lamp blue at station (operator: load pallet)
timeout: none (waiting for the operator is normal)
unclamp, lift, rotate 180°, lower, clamp, seat check
8.8 s nominal · timeout 15 s → step 90, alarm HMC01_A8020
Lamp blue · unload finished casting at station
if B_CC1 full: wait (yellow lamp, no alarm)
AND convergence: continue only when 32 AND 42 are active
report 'part done' to MES (OPC UA), GoodCount + 1
Fault step 90 is reached from any step by its timeout (forcing rule) – not drawn as lines to keep the chart readable.
N = while step active · S = set (stored)
R = reset · P1 = once on step entry
Twin config: change_s = 15 s, so the
twin shows 360 s until 'Use in twin' = 8.8 s
GRAFCET of the HMC01 machine-tending cell
